opinion: The exact current English, Korean and includes are expressly about another participant. Generic participant.role prefixes, context owner and human applicability are structural/eligibility bounds and do not independently broaden that meaning to any main actor role. The common source peer-rival prerequisite is semantically justified, but its truth does not alone establish fit to this secondary/other-participant slot. The previous whole-record participant_role judgement is therefore not justified under a strict reading of final142V2; treat that role pair as pending, not all source facts as wrong.
recommended_followup: Preserve source, all prerequisite facts/guards and the no-counterpart boundary. Prefer an explicit immutable follow-up role revision withholding participant_role for common main actor while retaining other independently justified roles. A genuinely intended generic role catalog needs an explicit whole-spec clarification/provenance/acceptance and fresh binding, not an inferred prefix override. Selected help may warrant its own separate role review, but do not automatically transplant common actor evidence to helper, infer an already-declared helper role from an activity, or add a counterpart to satisfy this slot.
